question: Is a Claude subagent whose `tools` is `Read` offered a connected MCP server's tools when it runs in the background, where the same agent run in the foreground is offered none and a background subagent with no `tools` field is offered all of them?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(.system | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-CCBG6"))]; def offered: [(.[] | .tools[]?.name), (.[] | .. | strings | select(contains("The following deferred tools are now available via ToolSearch")) | split("\n")[])] | map(select(startswith("mcp__fx__"))) | unique; with_entries(.value |= (governed | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" else offered end))
